description:
List the Items of a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K or 20-F: which sections the filing has and where.

Each entry gives the item ("1A", "7", "2.02"), its part ("I".."IV"; 10-Q
items repeat across Part I and Part II), the SEC's title, the heading as
the filer wrote it, its length in characters, and a highlight_url that
opens the filing with that whole section marked. Read one with
get_filing_item. Items are found by their headings in the document, not
by searching for the words "Item 1A", so a table of contents or a
cross-reference is never mistaken for the section.

not_located lists the form's items that were not found: the filing may
not have them (Item 1C before 2023, a 10-K/A carrying only Part III, the
many 8-K items a given 8-K doesn't report), or the heading was missed.
get_filing_item still answers for those, with the text between the
neighbouring items. Other forms (6-K, 40-F, DEF 14A, S-1...) have no
numbered Items: read them with search_document or get_document.

Args:
    accession_number: SEC accession number of a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K or 20-F (e.g. "0000320193-25-000079")
name: list_filing_items
title: List Filing Items
